summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Bryson and Rahm's US Open Prep
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm are expected to be better prepared for the US Open than LIV Golf players, addressing a major criticism of LIV's impact on readiness for majors.

items.headline: PGA Tour Field Thin at Colonial
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm gained leverage as the PGA Tour Charles Schwab Challenge field at Colonial Country Club is underwhelming, featuring only one top-10 OWGR player.

items.headline: Rory's Putting Advice in 2024
items.text: In February 2024, Rory McIlroy advised Scottie Scheffler to switch to a mallet-style putter at the Genesis Invitational to improve his margin for error.
